label: TP
reason: User input from query string flows directly into HTML via printf-style formatting (%1$s/%2$s) without any HTML entity encoding or escaping. The presence of X-XSS-Protection: 0 header confirms intent to allow scripts, and the list manipulation does not sanitize the extracted parameter.

evidence.note: Parameter extracted from query string and decoded, then used unsafely in formatted HTML output.
Unsafe sink: User-controlled variable passed to PrintWriter format method which writes raw content into HTML body.
